# 1. Install R packages

<br>

* **Information on the R packages required by PRIDe-RL:**

The application requires `shiny`, `kableExtra`, and `xml2`. Open this file in
RStudio and click **Run Current Chunk**. Packages already installed will not be
reinstalled. When every package is reported as `TRUE`, open `app.R` and click
**Run App**, or run `shiny::runApp()` from the application directory.

```{r install-pride-rl-packages, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}

################################################################################
########################### CLICK RUN CURRENT CHUNK ############################
################################################################################


install.packages.PRIDe.RL <- function(Packages = NULL) {


  ## 1.1. Packages required by the PRIDe-RL application


  if (is.null(Packages)) {
    Packages <- c("shiny", "kableExtra", "xml2")
  }

  Packages <- unique(as.character(Packages))
  Packages <- Packages[nzchar(Packages)]

  if (!length(Packages)) {
    stop("No package names were provided.", call. = FALSE)
  }


  ## 1.2. Use the official CRAN mirror when no repository has been selected


  repositories <- getOption("repos")
  if (is.null(repositories) || !length(repositories) ||
      identical(unname(repositories[[1L]]), "@CRAN@")) {
    repositories <- c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }


  ## 1.3. Install missing packages (first attempt)


  installed <- rownames(utils::installed.packages())
  missing_packages <- setdiff(Packages, installed)

  if (length(missing_packages)) {
    utils::install.packages(
      missing_packages,
      repos = repositories,
      dependencies = c("Depends", "Imports", "LinkingTo")
    )
  }


  ## 1.4. Verify that every package namespace can be loaded


  loaded <- vapply(
    Packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )


  ## 1.5. Retry packages that could not be loaded


  failed_packages <- names(loaded)[!loaded]

  if (length(failed_packages)) {
    utils::install.packages(
      failed_packages,
      repos = repositories,
      dependencies = c("Depends", "Imports", "LinkingTo")
    )

    loaded[failed_packages] <- vapply(
      failed_packages,
      requireNamespace,
      logical(1),
      quietly = TRUE
    )
  }


  ## 1.6. Build the package-status matrix


  package_count <- length(Packages)
  column_count <- min(3L, package_count)
  row_count <- ceiling(package_count / column_count)
  status_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = row_count * 2L, ncol = column_count)

  for (index in seq_len(package_count)) {
    row_index <- ((index - 1L) %% row_count) * 2L + 1L
    column_index <- ceiling(index / row_count)
    status_matrix[row_index, column_index] <- Packages[index]
    status_matrix[row_index + 1L, column_index] <- ifelse(
      loaded[index],
      "TRUE",
      "FALSE"
    )
  }

  status_data <- as.data.frame(status_matrix, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(status_data) <- rep("&nbsp;", column_count)


  ## 1.7. Define status colors


  background_color <- function(value) {
    ifelse(
      value == "TRUE",
      "#d4edda",
      ifelse(value == "FALSE", "#f8d7da", "transparent")
    )
  }

  text_color <- function(value) {
    ifelse(
      value == "TRUE",
      "#155724",
      ifelse(value == "FALSE", "#721c24", "black")
    )
  }

  background_matrix <- apply(status_data, c(1, 2), background_color)
  text_matrix <- apply(status_data, c(1, 2), text_color)


  ## 1.8. Create the installation-status table


  if (!requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "The kableExtra package could not be installed. Review the installation messages above and try again.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  status_table <- kableExtra::kbl(
    status_data,
    align = "c",
    escape = FALSE,
    caption = paste0(
      "<div style='text-align:justify;color:black;'>",
      "<strong>Table&nbsp;1.</strong>&nbsp;R package installation status.",
      "</div>"
    )
  ) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      full_width = FALSE,
      bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive")
    ) |>
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      seq(1L, nrow(status_data), 2L),
      bold = TRUE,
      color = "black",
      extra_css = "border-bottom:2px solid #dee2e6;"
    )

  for (column_index in seq_len(ncol(status_data))) {
    status_table <- kableExtra::column_spec(
      status_table,
      column_index,
      background = background_matrix[, column_index],
      color = text_matrix[, column_index]
    )
  }


  ## 1.9. Stop if any required package remains unavailable


  if (any(!loaded)) {
    warning(
      "The following packages remain unavailable: ",
      paste(names(loaded)[!loaded], collapse = ", "),
      ". Review the installation messages and system requirements.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }


  ## 1.10. Return the installation-status table


  status_table
}


install.packages.PRIDe.RL()


options(scipen = 999)

```
